baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction 'faces ... radiant/fresh' joins the observer-facing human front to N-D-R bloom and brightness.
baseline_models.mechanism: A favorable condition becomes perceptible on the body's public surface as fresh, blooming luminosity.

activation_trace.role: The face/front is the outward surface that meets an observer and supplies the visible locus.
Radiant freshness across face, color, and foliage supplies bloom and brightness to that locus.

changed_reading.before: Some faces are bright on that day.
changed_reading.after: The faces appear freshly in bloom: favorable condition has become visibly embodied on their observer-facing surface.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: W-J-H can present a direction or destination as well as a face, while N-D-R marks that facing as fresh and luminous.
baseline_models.mechanism: The face is read dynamically as a facing or orientation, so radiance qualifies a directional stance rather than only complexion.

activation_trace.role: Orientation, destination, and directed movement make the plural faces potential facings.
Fresh brightness gives the directional stance a visibly flourishing quality.

changed_reading.before: Radiance is a static facial appearance.
changed_reading.after: Radiance belongs to a facing: the persons' directional stance itself appears lit and fresh.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The face can stand for the person or self, allowing the predicate 'radiant/fresh' to exceed complexion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The outward face metonymically carries the condition of the whole person; visible bloom is the interface of an integral flourishing state.

activation_trace.role: Use of the face for the self or person widens the subject from skin to whole-person condition.
Fresh beauty and bliss supply the flourishing state attributed through the face.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a pleasing facial color.
changed_reading.after: It presents flourishing persons through the face, their whole condition surfacing as fresh radiance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: N-D-R includes the bright purity of gold and pure substance, applied here to the visible face/front.
baseline_models.mechanism: Radiance is materialized as unalloyed luster: a clarified, pure condition shines on the person's front like bright metal.

activation_trace.role: The visible face/front provides the surface on which luster can register.
Bright pure gold and unalloyed substance supply a material image of clarified luster.

changed_reading.after: Their glow can be pictured as unalloyed luster, making purity or clarification materially visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next clause gives the radiant facing an endpoint and an act: N-D-R brightness becomes the condition of an N-Z-R gaze directed toward the Lord.

activation_trace.role: Direction and destination let the face function as an oriented stance awaiting specification.
Fresh radiance supplies the visible state that the following encounter can explain.
Lordship and sovereignty identify the personal endpoint of the facing.
Directing sight or insight toward an object supplies the active gaze paired with radiance.

structural_cues: 75:22 and 75:23 are adjacent nominal clauses, with the feminine singular possessive and predicate in 75:23 continuing the plural faces distributively.
The paired participles n-dirah and n-zirah differ by one consonant and move from visible appearance to directed looking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bright faces, W-J-H orientation, lordship, and directed sight; I infer that encounter produces or explains the brightness, while simple simultaneity - bright and looking - remains live.

changed_reading.before: The faces possess a self-contained glow.
changed_reading.after: Their radiance is relational and directional, the visible condition of a face engaged in an encounter toward its Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated face-and-day frame creates two opposed public states: fresh radiance versus a grimacing face that anticipates a back-breaking event.

activation_trace.role: The observer-facing surface makes the favorable state publicly legible.
Fresh beauty and brightness establish the favorable pole of the contrast.
The exact return of the face/front supplies a common display surface for the opposite condition.
Facial grimacing and severe aversion supply the contracted negative pole.
A back-breaking calamity supplies the anticipated outcome pressing into the grimacing face.

structural_cues: 75:22 and 75:24 repeat indefinite plural faces, 'that day,' and a feminine singular participial predicate.
75:23 and 75:25 each extend one facial state, first by directed looking and then by anticipated catastrophe.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel syntax, opposite facial qualities, and the feared breaking event; I infer that the faces externalize divergent outcomes, while an immediate emotional reaction rather than a fixed outcome remains possible.

changed_reading.before: Radiance is a generally pleasant description.
changed_reading.after: Radiance is one pole in a facially legible divergence: the day sorts conditions by making them visible on the same public surface.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sight is first stunned and the ordinary celestial lights are eclipsed or collapsed together; the later radiance on human faces therefore reads as a counter-light not borrowed from the normal sky.

activation_trace.role: Fresh brightness on the face supplies the surviving human locus of luminosity.
The visible human front relocates light from the sky to a person-facing surface.
The startled, fixed eye supplies a mode of overwhelmed rather than composed seeing.
Ordinary eyesight supplies the perceptual faculty disrupted in the opening tableau.
The moon and its celestial light supply one normal external luminary that is withdrawn in the source sequence.
Gathering separated things supplies the collapse of the usual distinction between the two lights.
The sun and daylight supply the other normal external luminary drawn into that collapse.

structural_cues: 75:7-9 progresses from stunned sight to an eclipsed moon and the gathering of sun and moon.
The recurrence of 'that day' in 75:10 and 75:22 places cosmic disorder and facial radiance within one temporal tableau.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disrupted sight, failed celestial ordering, and later luminous faces; I infer a contrast that relocates meaningful light to persons, while the two images may instead be independent features of the day.

changed_reading.before: The faces are bright in an otherwise unspecified environment.
changed_reading.after: They bear a non-celestial counter-light: human radiance becomes conspicuous precisely when ordinary lights and ordinary seeing fail.

context_deltas.mechanism: The indictment of loving the immediate and abandoning the later is followed by a radiant facing directed beyond the immediate toward the Lord; luminosity becomes a visible temporal reorientation.

activation_trace.role: Orientation and destination let the face embody a chosen direction across time.
Fresh radiance marks the positive visible quality of the reoriented facing.
Love fixed in the heart supplies the attachment driving the prior temporal preference.
Haste and bringing something forward supply the pull of the immediate.
Leaving a thing supplies the abandonment side of the temporal opposition.
What comes after the first supplies the deferred horizon being left.
Lordship supplies the ultimate personal destination replacing attachment to immediacy.
Directed sight supplies the enacted orientation toward that deferred destination.

structural_cues: 75:20-21 forms an antithesis between the immediate and the later immediately before the face pair.
The preposition 'toward' in 75:23 converts temporal preference into a spatially directed gaze.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the indictment, then radiant faces and a directed gaze; I infer that juxtaposition offers radiance as the result of corrected orientation, but it does not explicitly identify the radiant group with a named prior subject, so rhetorical contrast remains live.

changed_reading.before: The radiance is an isolated reward-like appearance.
changed_reading.after: It is the visible signature of a changed horizon: the face no longer terminates in the immediate but opens toward the later destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The person is informed of the record, has inward sight against the self, and cannot hide behind excuses; the radiant face/front can therefore function as a nonverbal disclosure of whole-person condition.

activation_trace.role: The outward front that meets an observer supplies a public evidentiary surface.
The face standing for the self lets the surface disclose whole-person condition.
Fresh radiance supplies the favorable condition made legible on that surface.
A report brought and delivered supplies explicit disclosure of the person's record.
The thing itself or self supplies the object whose real condition cannot be displaced.
Insight of the heart supplies inward knowledge that precedes outward facial disclosure.
The branch image of excuses as curtains supplies attempted covering that the visible face defeats.
Revealing meaning through speech or sign supplies a model for the face communicating condition without words.

structural_cues: 75:13-15 moves from reported deeds to self-insight despite proffered excuses.
75:19 places clarification before the pivot into temporal preference and the opposed faces.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies report, self-insight, attempted covering, and disclosure by sign; I infer that facial radiance serves as embodied testimony, while it may instead be only an emotional consequence with no evidentiary function.

changed_reading.after: The radiant front actively discloses the person's true condition, a visible testimony that excuses cannot curtain.

context_deltas.mechanism: Flight and refuge fail, every movement converges toward the Lord, and the face's directional branch turns radiance into the settled mode of arrival rather than the panic of being driven.

activation_trace.role: Orientation and destination make the face a stance within the surah's converging movements.
Fresh radiance supplies the composed positive quality of one mode of arrival.
Flight and escape supply the panicked attempt to choose another direction.
Refuge supplies the unavailable alternative endpoint.
Lordship and sovereignty identify the unavoidable endpoint of movement.
Fixity and settlement supply arrival rather than continued flight.
Directed sight supplies a composed facing at the endpoint.
Driving and impelling supply the contrasting compelled mode of reaching the same destination.

structural_cues: 75:12 and 75:30 repeat 'toward your Lord that day' with settlement and driving, while 75:23 repeats 'toward her Lord' for the face.
The sequence moves from seeking escape to no refuge, settlement, directed gaze, and eventual driving.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies convergent destination language, failed escape, settlement, gaze, and driving; I infer that radiance distinguishes settled or willing facing from compelled arrival, while all clauses may describe inevitability without contrasting willingness.

changed_reading.before: The face is bright at a static judgment scene.
changed_reading.after: It is bright because its facing has come to rest at the destination, contrasting with flight and the compelled drive toward the same Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah frames the scene with gathered bones, precisely shaped members, development from a clear drop, creation, and life restored to the dead; facial freshness becomes the visible vitality of a reconstituted body.

activation_trace.role: The face standing for the person lets restored vitality characterize the reconstituted self.
Bloom of face, color, and foliage supplies the phenomenology of returned vitality.
Joining what was dispersed supplies bodily reconstitution from separated remains.
Intrinsic straightness and completion supply precise restoration down to the body's extremities.
Clear water ranging from drop to sea, including generative fluid, supplies life's small wet origin.
Bringing creation into existence supplies the transition from material stages to formed life.
Animate, ensouled life supplies the force visibly present in the fresh face.
Loss of force and life supplies the state that reanimation reverses.

structural_cues: 75:3-4 and 75:37-40 form a bodily gathering, formation, and re-creation frame around the focus.
75:40 closes by placing enlivening directly against the dead.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily reassembly, formation, wet generation, creation, life, and death; I infer that N-D-R bloom is the visible result of reanimation, while the freshness may instead mark favorable affect after resurrection rather than biological vitality itself.

changed_reading.before: Radiance is a surface ornament added after resurrection.
changed_reading.after: Radiance is the surface evidence of precise reconstitution and returned vitality: the recreated person visibly blooms with life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the Q-S-M occurrence is an oath and the cited branch is remote from that immediate sense; it remains anchored because the packet explicitly supplies 'beauty distributed in the face' and the focus explicitly joins faces to fresh beauty. Downstream prose should mark it as a lexical echo that textures the radiance, not as a claim that the oath means facial beauty.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus names plural faces and predicates N-D-R fresh beauty of them.

activation_trace.role: The physical face supplies the field across which qualities can be distributed.
Fresh facial beauty supplies the quality distributed across that field.
Beauty apportioned across the face supplies an ordered, feature-by-feature pattern rather than an undifferentiated glow.

changed_reading.before: The whole face emits a uniform brightness.
changed_reading.after: Its radiance may be patterned as beauty fittingly apportioned across the features, an ordered facial composition rather than a flat wash of light.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because D-H-B means 'went' in 75:33 and its gold/gilding branches are form-distant from that source use; it remains anchored in the focus's own N-D-R branch of pure bright gold and gains a local foil from swaggering display. Downstream prose should present an analogy between unalloyed radiance and plated display, never substitute 'gold' for the source verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: N-D-R at the focus carries a branch image of bright pure gold and unalloyed substance.

activation_trace.role: Bright pure gold supplies intrinsic, unalloyed luster for the radiant face.
Gilding and surface plating supply a foil of apparent luster laid over something else.
Swagger through an extended posture supplies the performative outer display associated with that foil.

changed_reading.before: Radiance and proud outward display are visually similar kinds of shine.
changed_reading.after: The focus can suggest unalloyed luster in contrast to a swaggering, gilded display: intrinsic clarification rather than surface performance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain reading because it treats a human face through water, foliage, and land imagery; it remains valid as an analogy because N-D-R explicitly includes foliage bloom, N-T-F supplies clear water, and H-Y-Y/M-W-T oppose rain-enlivened and dead land within branches activated by the creation ending. Downstream prose should call it a material analogy for restored vitality, not a lexical replacement for 'radiant.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: N-D-R fresh beauty explicitly spans face, color, and foliage, while W-J-H fixes that bloom on the human front.

activation_trace.role: The human face/front anchors the ecological analogy to the actual subject.
Bloom shared by face and foliage authorizes the fresh vegetative image.
Clear water from drop to sea supplies moisture as the material condition of freshness.
Earth revived by rain and vegetation supplies the model of life returning as visible green freshness.
Lifeless land supplies the dry baseline reversed by enlivening and bloom.

changed_reading.before: The face shines like a light source.
changed_reading.after: The face can also look freshly watered, like a formerly lifeless surface brought back into living bloom.

strongest_changes: The adjacent N-Z-R gaze revises static N-D-R glow into radiance generated or expressed by directed encounter.
The repeated grimacing faces make radiance one publicly legible pole of divergent outcomes.
Failed celestial lights make the faces a human counter-light, while the movement sequence makes them settled facings at the common destination.
The creation and resurrection frame turns freshness into visible reconstituted vitality rather than a merely decorative surface.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah branch activation preserved three easily flattened edges: beauty distributed across facial features, unalloyed luster contrasted with gilded swagger, and a watered-foliage analogy for restored life.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet supports coexistence of radiance and gaze more directly than a causal arrow from encounter to radiance.
W-J-H leaves live whether the primary locus is literal complexion, whole-person condition, or directional stance.
The counter-light, disclosure, gold, and ecological models are coherent analogies, but their degree of discourse-level intentionality remains uncertain.
